#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export DISPLAY="${DISPLAY:-:0}"
TITLE='FranKenstein -- live'
PID_FILE='/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/chrome.pid'
SCREEN2_X0=1680
SCREEN2_X1=2704
TARGET_X=1847
TARGET_Y=168
TARGET_W=746
TARGET_H=449
API='http://127.0.0.1:8788/api/schalten'
command -v xdotool >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'ERROR: xdotool missing' >&2; exit 20; }
find_windows(){ xdotool search --name "^${TITLE}$" 2>/dev/null || true; }
mapfile -t wins < <(find_windows)
if ((${#wins[@]} == 0)); then
  command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'ERROR: absent and curl unavailable; refusing ad-hoc Chrome launch' >&2; exit 21; }
  curl -fsS -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"an":true}' "$API" >/dev/null
  for _ in {1..20}; do sleep 0.25; mapfile -t wins < <(find_windows); ((${#wins[@]} > 0)) && break; done
fi
((${#wins[@]} > 0)) || { echo 'ERROR: buehne daemon did not create production window' >&2; exit 22; }
keep=''
tracked_pid=''
if [[ -r "$PID_FILE" ]]; then tracked_pid="$(tr -dc '0-9' < "$PID_FILE")"; fi
if [[ "$tracked_pid" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
  for wid in "${wins[@]}"; do wpid="$(xdotool getwindowpid "$wid" 2>/dev/null || true)"; if [[ "$wpid" == "$tracked_pid" ]]; then keep="$wid"; break; fi; done
fi
if [[ -z "$keep" ]]; then
  for wid in "${wins[@]}"; do geom="$(xdotool getwindowgeometry --shell "$wid" 2>/dev/null || true)"; x="$(printf '%s\n' "$geom" | sed -n 's/^X=//p' | head -1)"; if [[ "$x" =~ ^-?[0-9]+$ ]] && (( x >= SCREEN2_X0 && x < SCREEN2_X1 )); then keep="$wid"; break; fi; done
fi
[[ -n "$keep" ]] || keep="${wins[0]}"
for wid in "${wins[@]}"; do [[ "$wid" == "$keep" ]] && continue; xdotool windowclose "$wid" 2>/dev/null || true; done
xdotool windowmap "$keep" 2>/dev/null || true
xdotool windowsize "$keep" "$TARGET_W" "$TARGET_H" 2>/dev/null || true
xdotool windowmove "$keep" "$TARGET_X" "$TARGET_Y" 2>/dev/null || true
xdotool windowraise "$keep" 2>/dev/null || true
xdotool key --clearmodifiers --window "$keep" ctrl+r
sleep 0.35
mapfile -t after < <(find_windows)
printf 'AVATAR_SINGLETON_OK keep=%s tracked_pid=%s windows=%s target=%sx%s+%s+%s display=%s\n' "$keep" "${tracked_pid:-unknown}" "${#after[@]}" "$TARGET_W" "$TARGET_H" "$TARGET_X" "$TARGET_Y" "$DISPLAY"
((${#after[@]} == 1)) || exit 23
